spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_qhour_megacap
spec.hypothesis: At quarter-hour marks, prior-window taker buy/sell imbalance predicts short-horizon continuation on liquid megacap names; net edge survives costs where illiquid-basket tests (sprint32/34) did not, because spread/impact drag is far lower.
spec.power_argument: 8 symbols x ~90 trading days x 6 qhour marks/day, filtered to |imbalance-0.5|>0.15 (~15-20% fire rate) yields est. 650-850 entries, safely >=300. Return SD ~40bps intraday => SE~1.5bps at n=650 => min detectable net edge ~4-5bps at t=3, well below the ~35bps effect sizes that already failed on altbasket, so this is a real, distinguishable test not a rerun of a known-null.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
